Sky News has learnt that Andrew McNaughton is among a crop of new directors signed off by Jonathan Reynolds, who was reappointed as business secretary by Andy Burnham last week. Alongside Mr McNaughton, the government has hired Jon Bolton, co-chair of the UK Steel Council; Janet Ashdown, who serves on the board of London-listed Victrex; and David Bond, who oversaw Sheffield Forgemasters' transition into public ownership in 2021, as non-executive directors.
